messages:
incident-bot: ALERT 2001234567 — embeddings-service p95 latency > 1200ms for last 5m, error-rate up 3x. Pager escalated to oncall. https://build.alerts/INC-2001 :large_orange_diamond:
rebecca (oncall): acked, joining bridge. first look: dashboards show a sudden spike at 12:02 UTC, looks global but concentrated in us-west-2. checking autoscaler logs and cache hit rates.
darren (sre): saw similar. KV cache hit dropped from 92% -> 48% around 12:01. any deploys at that time?
leila (prod): yes, there was a small rollout to routing service at 11:59 to change preference routing for low-cost models. I thought it was harmless but will check rollout details.
ethan (eng): i'm on the routing change, can revert fast if needed. rolling back would take ~3m.
rebecca (oncall): try revert if you think it's related. meanwhile, can we scale embeddings pool by 2x?
darren (sre): triggering scale now: `kubectl scale deploy embeddings-pool --replicas=6` -> scaled. watching latency.
rebecca (oncall): scaling helped p95 drop to ~500ms after ~1:20. errors still present at ~0.5%.
maria (cs): flagged two paying customers reporting slow list embeddings in support queue. CS notified.
support-bot: Created ticket TKT-4452 and emailed customers with temporary mitigation note.
leila (prod): rollback started at 12:10, routing change reverted. Early telem suggests cache hit recovers once routed to previous variant.
darren (sre): confirmed: KV hit creeping back to 90% by 12:13, errors back to baseline. Looks like the routing change bypassed prefix caching path.
ethan (eng): root cause: new routing path didn't set cache-key namespace correctly for batched requests. will open a PR to add tests and enforce cache-key invariants.
rebecca (oncall): good catch. Customer impact: brief window 12:01–12:13, elevated latency and some 5xxs; only customers with long-prefix workloads affected. Need a postmortem and follow-ups.
leila (prod): urgent followups: 1) guardrails for routing changes 2) add rollout gating to integration tests 3) fix cache-key bug 4) notify impacted customers with timeline.
darren (sre): alert tuning notes: current paging threshold for p95 > 1000ms in any region fires immediately. That's noisy for short flaps. Suggest change: require sustained 3m window OR error-rate > 0.5% to page. Also add signal correlation to avoid paging on deploy-caused transient spikes.
rebecca (oncall): agreed. For now, lowering noise: add a suppression rule for deploy-tagged spikes for 10m with explicit opt-out. But keep high-severity pages for error-rate spikes.
ethan (eng): i'll add integration test asserting cache-key exists on routing path and a simple synthetic that exercises long-prefix embeddings.
maria (cs): i'll draft customer comms and sync with support. ETA for email: today EOD.
rebecca (oncall): ok let's capture action items and owners — i'll own the postmortem writeup and scheduling. Draft due tomorrow noon. Assignments:
- rebecca: lead postmortem and timeline (due 24h)
- ethan: fix cache-key bug + tests + PR (due 48h)
- darren: alert rule changes and backstop suppression config (due 72h)
- leila: rollout gating + add deployment tag propagation in telemetry (due 72h)
- maria: customer comms draft + support ticket updates (due EOD)

rebecca (oncall): creating postmortem thread and calendar invite for RCA review w/eng+sre+prod. Proposed slot: tomorrow 16:00 UTC. 
darren (sre): also adding a synthetic check: push traffic pattern that mimics long-prefix requests to catch regressions; will land this as a smoke job.
ethan (eng): PR opened: https://git.internal/pr/5421 - includes unit tests and a regression test harness.
leila (prod): rolling policy change: require integration test pass for routing changes that touch cache path. I'll update PR template today.
maria (cs): support ticket updated with rollback note and expected follow-up email. Customers asked for root cause.
rebecca (oncall): postmortem fields to include: timeline, customer impact list, root cause, corrective actions, preventative actions, monitoring changes, owner and due dates. I'll create doc and link here.
support-bot: Postmortem doc created: https://docs.internal/postmortem/PM-2001 (private).
darren (sre): follow-up monitoring improvements: 1) p95 paging: change to 3m sustained OR error-rate>0.5%; 2) add correlated alert that requires cache-hit <60% + p95>800ms to page; 3) tag deploys in alerts to suppress transient deploy-caused pages.
rebecca (oncall): accept. Please file PRs for alert rule changes and include test plan.
leila (prod): will add rollout gating checklist and update runbooks. Also propose a short on-call playbook for cache-eviction spikes.
ethan (eng): timeline for fix -> merged in 36h, deploy after smoke tests.
maria (cs): email to impacted customers drafted, will send after internal review.
rebecca (oncall): closing the live bridge. Thanks everyone for fast response. Leaving thread open for postmortem artifacts and follow-ups. :thumbsup:
